management.claim: Alphabet revenues grew 24% in the quarter, with Google Cloud growth accelerating to 82%.
management.quote: Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 24%, or 23% in constant currency, to $119.8 billion

management.claim: Operating income grew 30% and operating margin rose to 34%.
management.quote: Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.

management.claim: Other income was a large net gain, mainly unrealised gains on equity securities.
management.quote: Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily the result of net unrealized gains on our equity securities.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO calls Q2 an amazing quarter and describes the results as outstanding, with no headwind named.

guidance.text: Amazon expects third quarter 2026 net sales of $197.0 billion to $202.0 billion, growth of 9% to 12%.
guidance.quote: Net sales are expected to be between $197.0 billion and $202.0 billion, or to grow between 9% and 12% compared with third quarter 2025.

management.claim: Net sales grew 20% year over year in the quarter.
management.quote: Net sales increased 20% to $200.6 billion in the second quarter, compared with $167.7 billion in second quarter 2025.

management.claim: Operating income rose to $27.5 billion from $19.2 billion a year earlier.
management.quote: Operating income increased to $27.5 billion in the second quarter, compared with $19.2 billion in second quarter 2025.

management.claim: Net income included a large non-operating gain, mainly from investments in Anthropic.
management.quote: Second quarter 2026 net income includes non-operating pre-tax other income of $53.4 billion, primarily from our investments in Anthropic.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO says AWS is booming and advertising had a strong quarter, and looks forward to the second half.

guidance.text: Meta expects fourth quarter 2026 total revenue of $73-76 billion.
guidance.quote: We expect fourth quarter 2026 total revenue to be in the range of $73-76 billion.

management.claim: Revenue grew 26% year over year, on both a reported and constant currency basis.
management.quote: Revenue was $64.60 billion, an increase of 26% year-over-year on both a reported and constant currency basis.

management.claim: Costs and expenses rose 68%, including a litigation charge.
management.quote: Total costs and expenses were $51.61 billion, an increase of 68% year-over-year. This includes the litigation charge as discussed above.

management.claim: Meta expects to keep investing aggressively in the core business and AI.
management.quote: we expect to continue investing aggressively to support both our core business and emerging AI initiatives.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO says the core business is strong and investments are paying off; the release also notes the legal charge.

management.claim: Earnings per share were $4.21, lower than the second quarter and higher than a year earlier.
management.quote: We reported earnings per share of $4.21, 3% lower than the second quarter and 34% higher than the third quarter of 2025

management.claim: Results reflected higher net interest income, offset in part by higher operating expenses and lower non-interest income.
management.quote: These results reflected higher net interest income, stable underlying credit trends and continued

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO is pleased with the quarter and calls credit metrics stable, while staying attentive to economic conditions.

guidance.text: GrafTech expects fourth quarter realised pricing to rise by a mid-single-digit percentage from the third quarter.
guidance.quote: For the fourth quarter, we anticipate a mid-single-digit percentage increase in our weighted-average realized pricing compared to the third quarter.

management.claim: Net sales fell 3% year over year, mainly on lower realised pricing.
management.quote: Net sales for the third quarter of 2026 were $140 million, a decrease of 3% compared to $144 million for the third quarter of 2025, primarily driven by lower weighted-average realized pricing.

management.claim: The CEO believes realised pricing has reached an inflection point and expects higher pricing in 2027.
management.quote: Pricing momentum across our key commercial regions reinforces our confidence that our realized pricing has reached an inflection point, positioning us for meaningfully higher realized pricing in 2027.

management.claim: The Monterrey closure is expected to save $20 to $25 million in annual cash costs.
management.quote: expected to generate $20 to $25 million in annual cash cost savings while better aligning production capacity with market demand

tone.label: balanced
tone.reason: The CEO is confident on pricing and cost actions, while the quarter shows a net loss and lower sales.
